tasks.label: Build
tasks.detail: Compile a debug build at target/debug/starcrypt. This is the default build task.

tasks.label: Build And Install
tasks.detail: Build the release binary, run the regular test suite, and install StarCrypt into Cargo's bin directory.

tasks.label: Build Release
tasks.detail: Compile an optimized build at target/release/starcrypt.

tasks.label: Check
tasks.detail: Check all Rust targets for compiler errors without building a runnable binary.

tasks.label: Check Formatting
tasks.detail: Report rustfmt differences without editing files.

tasks.label: Clippy
tasks.detail: Lint all Rust targets and fail on any warning.

tasks.label: Format
tasks.detail: Apply rustfmt to the Rust source files.

tasks.label: Package Release
tasks.detail: Build and package the host macOS architecture in dist/; refuses existing output.

tasks.label: Test
tasks.detail: Run the regular test suite, including unit and integration tests.

tasks.label: Test External Archive Readers
tasks.detail: Optional compatibility check; requires unzip and 7zz on PATH.

tasks.label: Test Unit Tests
tasks.detail: Run only the library and CLI unit tests.

tasks.label: Verify
tasks.detail: Check formatting, run Clippy and the regular test suite, then build the release binary.
